name: Skills library and an agent's Skills tab render the seeded links
description: Covers the one class of risk the RTL suites structurally cannot: both skills screens read the REAL API across a process boundary, and every unit test for them stubs `fetch`. Two joins only exist on the server and are invisible to those stubs — GET /skills/:id/agents (which resolves 'Attached to' by joining agent_skills through agents) and GET /agents/:id/skills (which inlines the skill row into each link). Either could return the wrong shape and every client test would still pass. Read-only seeded data: it opens, clicks a card and a tab, and asserts — it creates, toggles, reorders and detaches nothing, so it neither mutates the DB nor triggers a model call. Fixtures come from server/src/db/seed-skills.ts (four skills; uncovered-branches + corner-cases + mocking-discipline linked to Test Quality Reviewer in that order, api-contract-gate linked to General Reviewer) — change that seed and this flow changes with it. Note the absent assertion on the 'Attach a skill' heading: `wait --text` compares RENDERED text and that heading is `text-transform: uppercase`, so it only ever matches as 'ATTACH A SKILL'. Asserting the section's content (api-contract-gate being offered) is both stabler and a stronger claim than asserting its label.
